html: From my own experience, the advantages of a big-name supervisor are these. Lots of people visit the institute, which broadens your horizons and your circle. At conferences, having your supervisor’s name on your talk guarantees an audience, and people come up to you afterward, which raises your profile and widens your circle further. Your papers get accepted more often. And you’re relatively sought after when you look for a job or a postdoc, because employers figure that a big name’s students come with a quality guarantee.
